answer_text:
Connecting support to your CRM means agents see deal and account context on every ticket. Options that do this well:

1. Brightdesk - strong reporting and automations, though the interface feels dated.
2. Orbitly - teams use its forms and boards as a basic request tracker.
3. Halcyon Sales - not a support tool, but integrates with most help desks.

If support is your main workflow, go with Brightdesk; otherwise Orbitly keeps things simpler.

mentions.name: Brightdesk
mentions.sentiment_reason: Strengths are noted alongside a clear drawback.

mentions.name: Orbitly
mentions.sentiment_reason: Listed factually without praise or criticism.
